## `neuro.number.isFinite`

Static method on `Number`.

> Returns true if passed value is finite.
> Unlike the global isFinite, Number.isFinite doesn't forcibly convert the parameter to a
> number. Only finite values of the type number, result in true.

## Signatures

```ts
isFinite(input: { number: unknown; prompt?: string }): Promise<boolean>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Number.isFinite` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
